---
name: refine
description: Use when clarifying or tightening a task's requirements before planning and implementation.
---

# Refine requirements

- Convert the request into a concise problem statement without prescribing a solution prematurely.
- Identify users and behavior in scope, explicit exclusions, constraints, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
- Separate known facts from assumptions. Resolve material ambiguity with focused questions using the ask-user tool; do not silently choose between materially different behaviors.
- Keep acceptance criteria observable and specific enough to verify.
- Return a concise, agreed task definition and note any remaining assumptions or risks for the planning step.
- Do not make remote changes, commit, or push.
